title: 第4章 美女总裁的贴身保镖！

第0004章 美女总裁的贴身保镖！

一道苍老却又中气十足的声音，自总统套房的阳台响起。

叶乘风顺着声音走去，便是瞧见一名身着军装的老者，此刻独坐在阳台，看着高楼下的滚滚车流。

叶乘风嘿嘿笑着过去，见旁边有多准备一个位置，便毫不客气地坐下。

被叫做老头子的老者，其实是华夏官方秘密组织隐龙隐凤的总负责人，云老。

而叶乘风，则是隐龙隐凤的总教官兼隐龙组组长，上将军衔，他的部下。

但叶乘风对云老，却完全没有什么上司与部下的区别，整个一自来熟。

“顺利个屁，遇上真理教那帮恐怖分子劫机了。”

云老呵呵笑道，根本不用询问过程，便能猜出大致情况。

“说吧，这次什么事情，我很忙的。”

叶乘风点起一支香烟，深深地吸了一口。

“去保护一个人，没有时间期限，而且暂时不能让她知道你是官方派来的。”

云老从侧旁的茶几上，拿起一叠档案资料，轻轻放在叶乘风的手中，微微叹了口气，有些凝重道：“她叫林紫薇，是林氏生物科技集团的总裁。”

叶乘风略微翻了翻资料，上面除了介绍林紫薇的基本情况，以及大概喜好和生活习惯之外，便没有其他了。

身为隐龙隐凤的总教官，叶乘风不敢说天下第一，但在整个华夏军界，他还没有遇到一个能在他手中走过三招的人。

因此，云老要他这样的身份和实力，去保护一个看起来顶多就是漂亮懂得经营公司的美女总裁，会不会太过了？

居然还没有时间期限，也不能让她知道自己来自官方！

看来，这个美女总裁，似乎很排斥官方的人啊。

云老嘿嘿道：“但背地里的资料，就得靠你自己去发觉了，因为这里是酒店，我怕隔墙有耳，就不对你多说。总之让你去，绝不会杀机用了宰牛刀，我还有点儿担心你应付不来。”

叶乘风忍不住微微惊呼，神色不自觉地凝重了几分。

云老的性格，他是知道的，从来不会在任务的事情上面开玩笑。

也就是说，云老认定这个任务对他叶乘风而言有难度，那绝对就是有难度。

难不成，这个叫林紫薇的美女总裁，还是一个很难相处的主儿？

“去吧，你的新身份是退伍军人，名字还叫叶乘风。”

云老递出一个文件袋：“这里边，除了你的相关证件资料，还有一株阳元草，是提前给你的报酬，以后每月至少一株，寻不到会让你到奇珍阁去选取其他物品替代，保证让你满意。而颜怡月，则是暗中辅助你的人。”

叶乘风打开文件袋一看，顿时感觉到一阵浓郁的灵气从阳元草溢散，于是爽快答应，根本连任务细节都没有询问。

对于任务，他从来不会怎么在意有多难。

最最让他看重的，其实是任务奖励！

虽然说，他是云老的第一部下，是华夏的上将，是隐龙隐凤的总教官兼隐龙组组长，但这其实都是云老为了拉拢他而安排的职位。

真正来讲，叶乘风与云老，或者说与华夏官方之间，其实有点像雇佣关系。

华夏官方给钱给物，叶乘风就帮忙处理一些华夏官方不宜出面的麻烦事情。

比如剿灭敌国特工，盗取敌国重要资料文件，刺杀敌国指挥官等。

叶乘风是一个修真者，而且还极有可能是全球唯一的一个。

重点是，如今的地球各种污染，已经到了灵气几近枯竭的地步，修真资源极其稀有罕见。

而恰好的是，有很大一部分修真资源，与古武修炼资源，其实都有着几乎相同的用处，偏偏叶乘风要忙着修炼，根本没有太多功夫去寻找。

而且就算有功夫去找，他也是一个人，效率有限。

所以，他以古武者身份，加盟了华夏隐龙隐凤，依靠官方的力量去帮忙寻找修真资源。

“对了，差点忘记告诉你了，那林紫薇与东方雪是校友兼闺蜜，集团总部地点在沪城，你的老家。”

叶乘风听到这里，顿时感觉被阴了一把。

如果云老提前把这一信息说出来，他可能不会接这个任务。

林紫薇倒没什么，叶乘风与她并无瓜葛。

叶乘风忽然想起了飞机邻座上的那个冰山美女。

酒红色披肩秀发，银灰色连衣短裙，黑色丝袜，白色长筒软靴……还有那凹凸有致的诱惑娇躯……以及那个如蜻蜓点水般的轻吻……

“我的身份和职业，就是这位女士的老公。”

“今天谢谢你了，我叫东方雪，敢问恩人贵姓？”

云老嘿嘿笑道：“其实我觉得吧，有些事情该解决的，还是得尽早解决。你这样拖拖拉拉，反而没什么好处。另外，沪城的叶家，这些年也发生了不少事情，你要不要回去看看？”

叶乘风哼了一声，眼神有些冰冷：“早在十年前，我便与他们毫无瓜葛了，叶家是叶家，我是我。”

云老叹了口气：“你明天就可以到沪城的林氏生物科技集团报道上班，初始职位是保安，具体要怎么做才能接近林紫薇，并取得她的信任当上她的贴身保镖，就看你的本事了哈。”

“不过就我所知，那林紫薇似乎还未意识到，即将面临的重大危机，如果你能抢先成为他的贴身保镖，那么这个任务就算成功了四分之一。当然，如果不能当上她的保镖，那你只能在暗地里保护她了。”

“任务的事情，老头子你就不必操心了，既然我答应接了，就一定会完成。”

从资料上看，林紫薇就是一个很有经营天赋的美女总裁，除了钱多和长得漂亮有可能惹来危机之外，叶乘风暂时也想不到其他的了。

但如果只是钱多和长得漂亮，叶乘风想，应该不至于让国家主动请人保护她。

而且云老，还如此大费周章地，让他这个隐龙隐凤的总教官出马。

除非，林紫薇这个人的能力，或者说她拥有的东西，对华夏乃至全世界的国家都可以起到无比巨大的帮助作用，完全值得华夏官方主动派人在暗中保护她。

而且，一派就是他叶乘风这么牛叉叉的！

“看来，这个美女总裁，远远没有表面上的那么简单啊！”
content_en:
Chapter 0004 The beautiful CEO’s personal bodyguard!

An old but powerful voice sounded from the balcony of the presidential suite.

Ye Chengfeng followed the sound and saw an old man in military uniform sitting alone on the balcony, watching the traffic rolling downstairs.

Ye Chengfeng chuckled and walked over. Seeing that there was a seat ready next to him, he sat down unceremoniously.

The old man called the old man is actually Mr. Yun, the head of the Chinese official secret organization Yinlong Yinfeng.

Ye Chengfeng, on the other hand, is the chief instructor of Yinlong Yinfeng and the leader of the Yinlong Group, with the rank of general, and one of his subordinates.

But Ye Chengfeng and Mr. Yun did not differentiate between superiors and subordinates at all. They were all familiar with each other.

"It went so well. We encountered a group of terrorists from the Truth Cult who hijacked the plane."

Mr. Yun chuckled and said that he could guess the general situation without asking about the process.

"Tell me what happened this time, I'm very busy."

Ye Chengfeng lit a cigarette and took a deep drag.

"To protect someone, there is no time limit, and you can't let her know that you are officially sent."

Mr. Yun picked up a stack of archives from the coffee table beside him, put it gently in Ye Chengfeng's hand, sighed slightly, and said solemnly: "Her name is Lin Ziwei, and she is the president of Lin's Biotechnology Group."

Ye Chengfeng flipped through the information briefly. Apart from introducing Lin Ziwei's basic information, as well as her general preferences and living habits, there was nothing else.

As the chief instructor of Yinlong Yinfeng, Ye Chengfeng dare not say that he is the best in the world, but in the entire Chinese military world, he has not met anyone who can pass the three moves in his hands.

Therefore, would it be too much for Mr. Yun to ask his identity and strength to protect a beautiful CEO who looks pretty and knows how to run a company?

There is no time limit yet, and she can't let her know that she is from the official!

It seems that this beautiful CEO is very repulsive to official people.

Mr. Yun said hey, "But you have to discover the information behind your back. Because this is a hotel, I'm afraid the walls have ears, so I won't say anything more to you. Anyway, I let you go, and I won't kill you with a knives. I'm a little worried that you can't handle it."

Ye Chengfeng couldn't help but exclaim slightly, and his expression became a little more solemn unconsciously.

He knew Mr. Yun's character and would never joke about mission matters.

In other words, if Mr. Yun decides that this task is difficult for him, Ye Chengfeng, then it is definitely difficult.

Is it possible that this beautiful CEO named Lin Ziwei is still a difficult master to get along with?

"Go ahead, your new identity is a veteran, and your name is Ye Chengfeng."

Mr. Yun handed over a document bag: "In addition to your relevant identification information, there is also a Yang Yuan grass here as a reward for you in advance. From now on, there will be at least one plant every month. If you can't find it, you will be asked to go to the Qizhen Pavilion to choose other items to replace it. I guarantee you will be satisfied. And Yan Yiyue is the person who secretly assists you."

Ye Chengfeng opened the document bag and took a look, and immediately felt a burst of rich spiritual energy emanating from Yang Yuan Grass, so he readily agreed without even asking about the details of the mission.

He never cared much about how difficult a task was.

What matters most to him is actually the mission reward!

Although he is said to be Mr. Yun's first subordinate, a general of China, the chief instructor of Yinlong Yinfeng and the leader of the Yinlong Group, these are actually positions arranged by Mr. Yun in order to win over him.

To be honest, the relationship between Ye Chengfeng and Mr. Yun, or the Chinese official, is a bit like an employment relationship.

The Chinese officials gave money and things, and Ye Chengfeng helped deal with some troublesome matters that the Chinese officials should not intervene in.

For example, destroy enemy agents, steal important information and documents of enemy countries, assassinate enemy commanders, etc.

Ye Chengfeng is a cultivator, and he is most likely the only one in the world.

The point is that today's earth is polluted to the point where spiritual energy is almost exhausted, and cultivation resources are extremely rare.

It just so happened that a large part of the cultivation resources and ancient martial arts training resources actually had almost the same use, but Ye Chengfeng was busy practicing and didn't have much time to look for them.

And even if you have the time to find him, he is still alone and his efficiency is limited.

Therefore, as an ancient warrior, he joined Huaxia Hidden Dragon Hidden Phoenix and relied on official power to help find cultivation resources.

"By the way, I almost forgot to tell you that Lin Ziwei and Dongfang Xue are schoolmates and best friends. The headquarters of the group is in Shanghai, your hometown."

When Ye Chengfeng heard this, he suddenly felt betrayed.

If Mr. Yun had told this information in advance, he might not have accepted this task.

Lin Ziwei is fine, and Ye Chengfeng has nothing to do with her.

Ye Chengfeng suddenly remembered the iceberg beauty sitting next to him on the plane.

Burgundy shawl hair, silver-gray short dress, black stockings, white soft boots... and that seductive and concave body... and that gentle kiss like a dragonfly touching water...

"My identity and profession is this lady's husband."

"Thank you for today. My name is Dongfang Xue. May I ask my benefactor's surname?"

Mr. Yun chuckled and said: "Actually, I think there are some things that should be resolved as soon as possible. It will do no good if you procrastinate like this. In addition, a lot of things have happened to the Ye family in Shanghai over the years. Do you want to go back and take a look?"

Ye Chengfeng snorted, his eyes a little cold: "As early as ten years ago, I had nothing to do with them. The Ye family is the Ye family, and I am me."

Mr. Yun sighed: "You can report to work at Lin's Biotechnology Group in Shanghai tomorrow. Your initial position will be security. How you can get close to Lin Ziwei and gain her trust to become her bodyguard depends on your ability."

"But as far as I know, Lin Ziwei doesn't seem to realize the major crisis she is about to face. If you can become his personal bodyguard first, then the mission will be a quarter successful. Of course, if you can't be her bodyguard, then you can only protect her secretly."

"Old man, you don't have to worry about the mission. Since I agreed to take it, I will definitely complete it."

Judging from the information, Lin Ziwei is a beautiful CEO with great business talent. Apart from having a lot of money and being beautiful, which may cause crises, Ye Chengfeng can't think of anything else for the time being.

But if it was just a lot of money and good looks, Ye Chengfeng thought, the country wouldn't have to take the initiative to hire someone to protect her.

Moreover, Mr. Yun went to such great lengths to get him, the hidden dragon and hidden phoenix chief instructor, to take action.

Unless Lin Ziwei's abilities, or what she possesses, can be of immense help to China and even countries around the world, it is completely worthy of the Chinese official's initiative to send people to protect her in secret.

Moreover, Ye Chengfeng is the one who is so awesome!

"It seems that this beautiful CEO is far from being as simple as she seems!"
